dispute_description: Party A manufactures biscuits under the registered trademark PARLE-G with a distinctive yellow and white wrapper with a child's image. Party B has launched a competing biscuit product under the name PARLE-GEE with a deceptively similar yellow wrapper and similar child imagery causing widespread consumer confusion in retail markets. Party A seeks permanent injunction and damages of Rs 50 lakhs. No prior contractual relationship exists between the parties.
